keyrock.label: Keyrock: 16,000+ unlocks across 40 tokens
keyrock.finding: About 90% of unlocks were followed by price pressure, starting about 30 days before. Team unlocks were worst (about -25%), investor and community unlocks moderate, ecosystem-development unlocks averaged +1.18%. Bigger unlocks hit harder; linear releases disrupt less than cliffs. Keyrock is a market maker and has not published its data.

thetie.label: The Tie: 12,350 unlocks in 2026
thetie.finding: The median unlock was 0.2% of a day's trading volume and 95.6% were under one day's volume. Their screen for unlocks that can move a market: more than a quarter of a day's volume.

tokenomist.label: Tokenomist: 236 unlocks
tokenomist.finding: Drops are real but conditional: concentrated in early-stage tokens with a thin float, and mostly priced in before the unlock date.

kim.label: Kim (SSRN): 52 Binance unlocks, 2023-2025
kim.finding: 46 of 52 major unlocks (88.5%) fell within 72 hours, mean -16.97%, in every Bitcoin market regime. Small, preliminary sample.

reasoning.label: Reasoning, not a study
reasoning.finding: Holders sitting on large gains have more reason to take profit; holders below their entry price have less. No study above measures this directly, so it carries a small weight.
